messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick invite 10:00 PT this Friday for a 35m all-hands. Agenda: 1) Executive check-in (Sam) 2) GA rollout recap & customer FAQ (Rohit) 3) Security policy tweak summary (Tess) 4) Hiring + action items. Please drop 1-2 Qs below or mark :hand:. Recording will be posted. Calendar: https://cal.example/ah-2123456789 :spiral_calendar:
Sam (CEO): 5min remarks. Focus: FY priorities and where teams should focus post-GA.
Rohit (Product): I'll cover GA metrics, migration notes, and the customer-facing timeline. Need a 60s demo clip  @Noah can you produce?
Noah (Comms): Yep I'll create a 60s highlight clip and a one-pager draft for customers. Upload by Thu EOD.
Ivy (Eng): Will we have a targeted rollback plan for early adopters? I'll add a slide with rollback steps.
Tess (Security): Heads-up: small change to audit log retention defaults for hosted orgs. We'll include an FAQ and link to the internal policy for feedback.
Maya (People Ops): Please add questions by Thu noon so we can curate a 6min panel. Accommodation requests DM me.
rec-bot: Event created: "All-hands 10:00 PT  GA Readout" Link: https://cal.example/ah-2123456789

--- post-call ---
rec-bot: Recording posted: https://recs.example/2123459000 100% processed captions.
Maya (People Ops): Notes & top takeaways: 1) GA is live; initial ramp looks healthy (p95 latency stable); 2) Migration options: auto-migrate vs. opt-in path - details in FAQ; 3) Security: audit log retention default increases to 90d for hosted by default with opt-out at org level; 4) Hiring: 4 IC roles and 2 staff hires approved; 5) Action: Product+Security to publish the migration guide and FAQ by next Wed. Slides/clip: https://drive.example/allhands-2123456789 :page_facing_up:
Sam (CEO): Appreciated the focused updates. Key callout: reduce manual customer friction during migration  all teams prioritize docs + runbooks.
Tess (Security): Internal policy draft: https://internal.example/policies/audit-retention-v3  comments open 72h.
Rohit (Product): Demo clip uploaded; ping with any customer edge cases.
Noah (Comms): Customer brief draft will be shared in #partners tomorrow for review.
Ivy (Eng): Caught up in recording 1 thanks for captions. I'll join the migration office hour on Thu. :thumbsup:
